FN-W1XSI55-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 91
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/23/2026
Senate Bill 91 as introduced would allow a county or municipality as part of a multijurisdiction
authority established by the Legislature to, by resolution, withdraw from the multijurisdiction
authority under certain circumstances. This could decrease receipts to the authority, and
simultaneously increase receipts to the withdrawing county or municipality, by an undetermined
amount dependent upon (1) the amount of unencumbered funds held by the authority that would
be reimbursed to the withdrawing county or municipality pursuant to this bill; and (2) the
amount of future tax receipts collected within the withdrawing county or municipality that
would no longer be distributed to the authority. Further, this bill could increase the obligations
of the non-withdrawing company by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount
needed to offset any decrease in receipts to the authority from the withdrawing county or
municipality.
Further, this bill would allow a county or municipality that withdraws from a multijurisdiction
authority to establish a similar authority within local boundaries and provide for (1) the
distribution or use of any monies previously distributed to the multijurisdiction authority for the
new authority; and (2) an increase or decrease in the rate of any tax collected by the county or
municipality in conjunction with the multijurisdiction authority.
